Ameriprise Financial Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.54% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ameriprise Financial Inc sold 942,402 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 25.64 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.30 billion, down from 26.59 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ameriprise Financial Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $938.35B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.22% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $190.91. About 12.81M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since July 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Ameriprise Financial Inc, which manages about $221.01B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in United Continental Holdings (NYSE:UAL) by 264,476 shares to 917,330 shares, valued at $63.73M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Cboe Global Markets Inc (NASDAQ:CBOE) by 620,819 shares in the quarter, for a total of 685,135 shares, and has risen its stake in Sage Therapeutics Inc (NASDAQ:SAGE).
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.79 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
